# goslop text fixture — cleanup then wrap-raise stays reportable (caniscrape
# config.py TP shape). Bare re-raise after cleanup is the safe sibling.
lang: python
file: config.py
---
def save(temp_file, path, data):
    try:
        write(temp_file, data)
        os.replace(temp_file, path)
    except Exception as e:
        if temp_file.exists():
            temp_file.unlink()
        raise Exception(f"Failed to save config.")
